note: Routes findings-driven maintenance of an already-judged skill: pull coeval findings, draft one bounded workshop patch, co-evolve the rubric through the guarded flow, gate pre-merge, open a PR for a human. It must stay out of findings-free skill editing, new skill or rubric authoring, eval-stack setup, verdict adjudication, and anything that merges.
should_trigger: Update our natural-writing skill based on what its coeval findings say — the bench has accumulated a month of adjudications.
The reviewers keep overriding the judge's verdicts on commit-style; fold those override reasons back into the skill.
Run the skill-maintenance loop on session-handoff: pull its findings, propose a bounded patch, and open the PR.
What do the coeval verdicts and failure clusters say we should fix in the test-discipline skill, and can you draft the patch?
Our judged skill's findings show a recurring failure cluster — turn it into a SKILL.md patch and validate it against the golden set before the PR.
Apply the latest coeval findings export to the drafting skill, including any rubric probe that has to move with it.

should_not.prompt: Tighten up the wording in our natural-writing SKILL.md — no eval data, I just think it reads clunky.
Write a brand-new skill for reviewing database migrations.
Author the first judging rubric for our new skill and calibrate it in coeval.
Set up ironside and coeval on my machine so we can start judging skills locally.
Adjudicate the pending coeval exceptions for me and promote the ones you agree with to the golden set.
The skill-patch PR is green — merge it and enable auto-merge for future maintenance PRs.
The gate keeps failing one golden case; just relax that rubric probe so the suite passes.
Review this pull request that changes our API error handling.
